responsibility: Declares the primary public representation and inline API for GCC’s GIMPLE IR. It introduces the gimple_code enum from gimple.def, checking/casting helpers for concrete statement subclasses, statement flags and subcode encodings, allocation-kind classification, and a large set of inline accessors/predicates for reading and writing operands, bodies, labels, OpenMP/OpenACC properties, transaction and return fields, and other per-statement data that all GIMPLE-producing and GIMPLE-consuming code in the middle end relies on.
same_name_distinction: Primary public representation/header for GIMPLE, exposing the enum from gcc/gimple.def plus inline accessors, predicates, and checking/casting helpers; unlike gcc/gimple.cc it does not implement the non-inline runtime support, and unlike gcc/gimple.def it is not the master declarative code inventory.
